metadata.title: Yayuhong Knitwear - Fast Fashion Sweater Factory | 20 Years Expertise
metadata.description: Yayuhong Knitwear Factory in Chenghai, 20 years of professional sweater manufacturing experience. 30,000 pieces daily capacity, 50 pcs MOQ, 7-day delivery. ODM/OEM/CMT services for global fast fashion brands and e-commerce platforms.

advantages.title: Why Choose Us
advantages.subtitle: Four core advantages to keep your knitwear business ahead of the curve

items.title: Small MOQ, Fast Turnaround
items.desc: Start from just 50 pieces with 7-day delivery. Keep up with fast fashion trends, reduce inventory risk, and quickly restock bestsellers.

items.title: Design Capabilities
items.desc: Professional design team launching 100+ new styles monthly. Following international fashion trends. ODM service with design references or tech packs.

items.title: Cost Advantage
items.desc: Source factory in Chenghai knitwear industrial belt with 30 production workshops. Cut out middlemen and save up to 30% vs trading companies.

items.title: Quality Assurance
items.desc: 20 years of craftsmanship with three quality inspection stages. Strict quality control on every piece with 99%+ pass rate for bulk orders.

factory.title: Factory Capabilities
factory.subtitle: 20 years of craftsmanship behind every sweater we make

features.title: Modern Production Base
features.desc: Located in Chenghai, Shantou - China's famous knitwear town. 30 production workshops with advanced computerized flat knitting machines.

features.title: Expert Technical Team
features.desc: 20 core technicians with 20+ years of experience. Professional control throughout design, pattern-making, and production.

features.title: Strict Quality Control
features.desc: Three quality inspection stages: raw material, semi-finished, and finished products. Ensuring quality in every piece.

features.title: Fast Response Service
features.desc: Professional sales team responds to inquiries within 24 hours. 3-5 days for sampling, 7-15 days for bulk production.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: One-stop knitwear solutions from design to delivery

items.title: ODM Development
items.desc: We provide original designs for you to choose from. 100+ new styles launched monthly, always on top of market trends.

items.title: OEM Manufacturing
items.desc: Provide us with your designs or samples, and we'll produce to your specifications. Full branding service including labels and hangtags.

items.title: Small Batch Fast Turnaround
items.desc: MOQ starting at 50 pieces with 7-day delivery. Perfect for e-commerce sellers, livestream clients, and emerging brands.

items.title: Large Volume Orders
items.desc: 30,000 pcs daily capacity. Handling brand bulk orders and export orders with installment payment and inspection support.
